_comment: Harness contract for optimising Reborn 303 parameters against a real ReBirth export. Copy to config.json and edit paths/params. The reference MUST be a 303-isolated, effects-off export (solo the acid line, effects rack off) so the objective reflects the 303, not a drum-dominated mix.

objective._band_weights_hint: Ten values, one per octave band [20-40, 40-80, 80-160, 160-315, 315-630, 630-1250, 1250-2500, 2500-5000, 5000-10000, 10000-20000]. For the Component A low-mid shelf, weight bands 3-5 (80-630 Hz) higher, e.g. [1,1,3,3,3,1,1,1,1,1]. Leave null for uniform.
objective._type_hint: band_distance is the objective visible in measure_ab.py. For the 303 brightness gap your methodology prefers the env-swept spectral centroid; wire that into metrics.env_swept_centroid_distance and set type to 'env_swept_centroid'.

_component_a_shelf_hint: Component A is a resonance-independent low-mid shelf. Once you expose its gain and corner as REBORN_* variables, add them here, for example: "shelf_gain_db": { "env": "REBORN_SHELF_GAIN_DB", "low": -3, "high": 6, "init": 0, "grid": 7 }, "shelf_freq_hz": { "env": "REBORN_SHELF_FREQ_HZ", "low": 200, "high": 800, "init": 400, "grid": 5 }. Names are illustrative; use whatever the engine reads.
